relations.quote: The procedure is applied to a [Finite linear network with roles and frames](linear-network-roles.md), whose wires include the auxiliary registers.

symbols.name: initial register value
symbols.meaning: The initial value of an auxiliary register, which may be any value.
symbols.quote: Let $\alpha$ denote the initial value of an auxiliary register, which may be any value.

symbols.name: computed scratch result
symbols.meaning: The value left in the register by the intended computation of stage 2, which depends only on the data.
symbols.quote: The computation starts from $0$ whatever $\alpha$ was, so the value $\gamma$ it leaves in the register depends only on the data, not on $\alpha$.
